cases.brief: A technician sees her reflection turn a fraction late, but the script never confirms whether the delay is real.
observables: Uses exact VIS01-V## rule IDs and resolves all VIS01-B## references.
Defines the point-of-view information boundary without explaining the ambiguity.
Defines aspect ratio, palette, contrast, texture, lens strategy, composition, and camera-height behavior.
Lists prohibited defaults and a motivated exception instead of unrelated attractive techniques.
Labels unconfirmed camera format, location, and reflection method as assumptions.

cases.brief: Across a desk, a witness begins intimidated and ends by revealing that she recorded the threat.
observables: Maps visual rules to the intimidation, discovery, and reversal beats.
Uses composition and camera-height changes only when the power shift earns them.
Keeps lens behavior consistent enough for blocking and shot-list departments to apply.

cases.brief: Two performers cross in a narrow service corridor with fixed overhead practicals and no room for a dolly.
observables: Treats the corridor, practicals, and lack of dolly space as supplied constraints.
Does not invent unavailable lenses, rigs, or lighting positions.
Separates visual-language rules from physical camera-movement instructions.
